description: This is a PHP source file defining a Drupal 7 migration source plugin class 'File' for migrating file data from the database, including methods for querying files, initializing paths, preparing rows, and defining fields and IDs.

classes.name: Drupal\file\Plugin\migrate\source\d7\File
classes.description: A Drupal 7 file source plugin class for migrating files from the database.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query to retrieve file records, filtering by scheme if configured.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Initializes public and private file paths from configuration variables.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each row by computing the 'filepath' property based on the URI and source base path.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array describing the fields available in the source data.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the primary key for the source data, which is 'fid'.
